# False Life (`spells:false-life`)
**Level 1 [Necromancy](../magic-schools/necromancy.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** Self
**Components:** V, S, M (a drop of alcohol) | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

You gain 2d4 + 4 Temporary Hit Points.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** You gain 5 additional Temporary Hit Points for each spell slot level above 1.
